sloka: प्रदक्षिणम् ऋषिम् कृत्वा शिरसा अभिप्रणम्य च ।जगाम स्व पुरम् राजा सभार्या रघु नन्दन ॥१-३८-१५॥
transliteration: pradakṣiṇam ṛṣim kṛtvā śirasā abhipraṇamya ca ।jagāma sva puram rājā sabhāryā raghu nandana ॥1-38-15॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus the king along with his wives, having circumambulated saint Bhrugu, bowed his head in reverence, saluted him with folded hands and returned to his capital.
translations.hindi: परन्तु हे देवताओं ! यह तो बतलाओ कि, जो मेरा तेज ( वीय ) स्थानच्युत हो गया हे, उसे कौन धारण करेगा ?
